Specification: This module specifies a one-variable system in which the Boolean variable x alternates value on every Next step. The initial state sets x = FALSE, and the action Next sets x' = ~x. The file also illustrates three wrapper operators at different levels: a state-level identity operator applied to Init, an action-level identity operator applied to Next inside a temporal box-subscript formula, and a temporal-level identity operator applied to the complete temporal formula [][Next]_vars. The temporal property verified by the configuration is Spec, which requires MyInit(Init) and the standard stuttering-closed safety formula [][Next]_vars.
